message.content:
Here’s a classic, fool‑proof list of ingredients for a moist, chocolate‑loving cake. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or sea salt) to suit your taste.

| Ingredient | Amount | Notes |
|------------|--------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb. |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process for richer flavor. |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or a mix of white + brown for extra moisture. |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Leavening agent; keep it fresh. |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with the acidity of the cocoa. |
| Salt | 1 tsp | Enhances sweetness and balances flavors. |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion. |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Or half‑milk, half‑buttermilk for extra tang. |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Neutral oil keeps the cake tender. |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Pure vanilla for depth. |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa, creates a silky batter. |
| Optional: 1 tsp espresso powder | 1 tsp | Intensifies chocolate flavor. |

**Optional extras for a richer cake:**
- **Dark chocolate chips or chunks** (½ cup) – folded in after the batter is mixed.
- **Buttermilk** (¼ cup) – replaces part of the milk for a tangy lift.
- **Ground cinnamon** (½ tsp) – adds warmth.

**Pro tip:** If you’re using a convection oven, reduce the baking temperature by about 25 °F (≈ 15 °C) and keep an eye on the cake, as convection ovens bake more evenly and quickly. Enjoy your chocolate creation!
